name: comfy-design
description: Generate images, video, audio, and 3D through a local ComfyUI MCP, with Comfy Cloud as an opt-in escalation for partner models and uploads.

description_i18n.en: Local-first ComfyUI for coding agents — generate images, video, audio, and 3D through the local ComfyUI MCP (comfy-mcp) on your own GPU; escalate to the hosted Comfy MCP (comfy-cloud) only for partner models and uploads.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 编码智能体本地优先生成：默认经本地 ComfyUI MCP（comfy-mcp）在本机 GPU 上做文生图/视频/音频/3D 与搜索；仅在需要伙伴模型或上传素材时升级到托管 Comfy MCP（comfy-cloud）。

comfy_api_key.title: Comfy API Key
comfy_api_key.description: 在 platform.comfy.org/profile/api-keys 创建（前缀 comfyui-）；留空则首次使用时走 OAuth 登录。
